portfolio.principle: Use a high-level forbidden-inference concept paper to own the cross-programme synthesis inside this track, while source methods papers retain implementation/theorem ownership and do not borrow novelty from the concept paper.

concept_track.title: More measurement is not more evidence: four failures of monotonic reasoning in ecology
concept_track.headline: Scientific evidence is not monotone in measurement amount, precision, latent information or repetition; adequacy is objective- and failure-architecture-relative.

four_failures.claim: More precision or more measurements along an existing observation direction need not improve structural identification.
More latent-state information need not be more useful for the declared scientific target.
More repeats inside one shared failure domain need not provide more independent evidential support.
Better downstream classification or inherited thresholds need not recover distinctions or operating meaning lost upstream or under representation shift.

translation/adapter example; explicitly not empirical evidence

concept_track.title: Mechanistic evidence needs an identification axis: measurement boundaries in ecological chains
concept_track.headline: Mechanistic proximity and identification strength are distinct axes.
concept_track.exclusive_owner: Boundary structural identification geometry, including k-rank(M), outside-row-span rank gain, product-preserving unidentified directions, Gamma/kappa proxy transport geometry, breakdown factor and anchor-ladder diagnostics.
concept_track.c2_interface: C2 may use Boundary only as the geometry-failure exemplar; theorem and diagnostic ownership remains in Boundary.
concept_track.ced_interface: CED may cite Boundary as an external identification-boundary source/contrast; CED does not own Boundary rank geometry.
concept_track.activation_rule: Submit independently only if C2 is declined, judged too broad, or an explicit firewall is retained so C1 owns identification geometry while C2 owns cross-failure non-monotonicity.

method_track.headline: Observation evidence should preserve unresolvedness and non-complementary support rather than force target semantics prematurely.
method_track.firewall: Own semantic restraint, operating-semantics calibration and controlled coarsening consequences; C2 may cite the forbidden inference but not re-own the method.

method_track.headline: Given unresolved mechanisms and a declared candidate family, rank and sequentially update the next observation by mechanism-learning value.
method_track.firewall: Own observation-design algorithm, sequential recomputation and frozen benchmark; C2 uses only the broader forbidden inference.

method_track.headline: Target-safe reportability, failure-aware refinement and risk-limited stopping need not coincide with full latent-world information.
method_track.firewall: Integrated Evidence manuscript is no longer the canonical submission unit; Boundary and MROD remain external sources/contrasts rather than absorbed ownership.
method_track.boundary_interface: Boundary retains structural identification geometry; CED begins from surviving compatible worlds and owns target-relative reportability, not k-rank(M).

method_track.headline: Ecological observation systems should retain discriminating side information and audit the opportunity universe before record-entry loss; an event table is not the opportunity universe.
method_track.firewall: TNOA is excluded and returns to M1. V3 contributes retained-information refinement; REC contributes external opportunity/reference auditing, irreversibility and transport-limited correction.
